_omni_rename_confirmed: PROBE-CONFIRMED 2026-08-30 on profile ffroliva (en): the Omni tier renders as 'volume_up Omni 1.1 Flash' and the Veo labels did NOT move — still 'Veo 3.1 - Lite / Fast / Quality'. Those two facts are byte-verified from this read. The RENAME ITSELF IS INFERRED, not byte-verified: the 'Omni Flash' baseline comes from a different account, locale and date (denon82, pt, 2026-08-26), so a single read cannot separate a global in-place rename from a cohort- or locale-gated label — the same confound _lower_priority_finding is careful about. What is independently corroborated is that has-text('Omni Flash') stopped matching for the #604 reporter on an account where it had worked. Treat 'Flow versions these names in place' as the working hypothesis the widened selector is robust to either way, not as an established fact (see KNOWN_ISSUES 2026-08-30 correction).
_lower_priority_finding: 'Veo 3.1 - Lite [Lower Priority]' was NOT offered on denon82 (2026-08-26, pt) and was NOT offered on ffroliva (2026-08-30, en). Two accounts at two moments in two locales, which is stronger than the single observation #539 opened on — but still NOT proof the tier does not exist: it may be cohort- or region-gated, which is what #539 remains open to establish. Recorded as observations with dates, per docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-26-model-cost-quota-catalog.md.
